package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for gzip_or_zip_writer_created_per_chunk: Gzip or zip writers recreated per chunk inside handler loops instead of reusing per stream.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
func scenario318Positive(w http.ResponseWriter) {
	chunks := []string{"hello", "world", "from", "gzip"}

	for _, chunk := range chunks {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		gw := gzip.NewWriter(&buf)
		gw.Write([]byte(chunk))
		gw.Close()
		w.Write(buf.Bytes())
	}
}
